summary.headline: SaVida Health secures $412K in annual savings across 5 spend categories; $358K already locked in
summary.narrative: Through a strategic-sourcing partnership with Treya Partners, SaVida Health has identified $412,065 in recurring annual savings spanning EMR, GPO Office & Medical Supplies, Telecom, and IT Hardware. The flagship win was a renegotiated Athena EMR contract that alone delivers $357,889 in yearly savings and is already in force. An additional $54,176 in savings is in various stages of contract signature, validation, and implementation, positioning SaVida for further cost reductions once the remaining initiatives are finalized.
